opis: The sunny henhouse yard from the reference picture. In the front middle, on the ground, a round straw NEST; in it a white EGG has just CRACKED open - the top of the shell lifted off, and a tiny fluffy yellow CHICK pokes its head and wings out, its beak wide open as it cheeps, little pieces of shell around it. A big white HEN with a red comb stands right beside the nest, bending her head down lovingly to her chick. Behind the nest, a little apart, the BUNNY crouches down with both paws on his cheeks, amazed and delighted; the OWL stands next to him smiling warmly with her wings folded; the FOX kneels at the other side, smiling. Golden afternoon light, warm and joyful - a new little life.
